# 610 - Qbar_BECD FIdx24 Probe Obstruction Terminal Basin Boundary Killfrontier Facet Route Edge Compositional Event Signature Contract Spec

## Status

Construction-spec refinement anchor. Layer I only; this is not an RH result.

## Pinch

Doc 609 kills the stronger interpretation of doc 608: the doc-608 typed
source-event classifier cannot be promoted merely by requiring every event rule
to be reused. Sixty-six of its 70 rule ids are singleton exact-tail,
obstruction-tail, or named-event rules.

Doc 610 changes the level of structure. It does not require each final
signature to be reused. It requires each primitive source-event feature used in
a signature to be reused by at least two boundary surfaces, and then composes
those reusable primitives into class-pure signatures. Exact tail names,
full-subject literals, doc-606 substring tokens, and doc-608 singleton rule ids
are forbidden as primitive evidence.

## Required Object

The new live object is:

```text
_ObstructionTerminalBasinBoundaryKillfrontierFacetRouteEdgeCompositionalEventSignatureReflectedFixedpointTraceExecutableGlobalContraction_source_square
```

This object strengthens doc 608 by adding eight acceptance clauses:

1. Doc 608 remains the base typed source-event classifier, and doc 609 remains
   the named no-go against reused event-rule promotion.
2. The primitive feature algebra uses only boundary kind, event kind,
   namespaces, raw segments, stemmed segments, raw/stemmed bigrams,
   raw/stemmed trigrams, and bounded suffix families.
3. A primitive feature may enter a signature only when it has support at least
   two across the 106 boundary surfaces.
4. No exact tail, full subject, doc-606 substring token, or doc-608 singleton
   rule id is allowed as primitive evidence.
5. The stem-normalized algebra has 184 reusable primitive features; the
   `basin` stem has support 12.
6. Raw reusable signatures leave exactly one ambiguity, while stem-normalized
   signatures leave none.
7. The classifier has 106 decisions, 98 class-pure signatures, and maximum
   signature bucket size four.
8. The resulting classes preserve the doc-608 winning class and doc-602 anchor
   composition on every boundary surface, including the doc-607 hard repair,
   without exact-tail or singleton-primitive evidence.

## Fail-Closed Exclusions

Missing or partial compositional event signatures, missing reusable primitives,
singleton primitives, exact-tail literals, full-subject literals, substring
tokens, missing stem normalization, unresolved raw ambiguity, ambiguous
signatures, class or anchor mismatches, reuse of doc-609 singleton rules as
evidence, noncompositional, nonminimal, infinite, non-source-internal,
nondeterministic, nonextensional, dependency-open, graph-unwired,
replay-unstable, proof-irrelevant, external, oracle-backed, branch-spawning,
unbounded, retuned, new-cell, context-collapse, declaration-only,
finite-sample, basis-row, or unbudgeted signature classifiers are diagnostics
only.
